tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All other terms & conditions are as per tender documents.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: a.Original Equipment Manufacturers OR Suppliers to Original Equipment Manufacturers/ ASRTU RC with OE status OR-If any firm is a supplier to OEM / firms under ASRTU RC with OE status for any of the Wheel Bearings/ Tapper Roller Bearings (T.R. Bearings/Hub Bearing) for Tata OR Leyland OR Eicher applications which are covered in the tendered items, their quoted rates will be considered for all other Types of Bearings irrespective of OE status.In case of Suppliers to OEMs, the Wheel Bearings/ Tapper Roller Bearings (T.R. Bearings/ Hub Bearing) part numbers covered in the Purchase Order & Invoice Copies placed by the OEMs viz., M/s. Ashok Leyland Ltd., M/s Tata Motors Ltd., and M/s. Eicher Motors Ltd., for any of the tender part number during the year 2023-24/ 2024-25/ 2025-26 will be considered for all the tendered items,.In case of ASRTU rate Contract firms, the Wheel Bearings/ Tapper Roller Bearings (T.R. Bearings/ Hub Bearing) part numbers covered in the valid RC with OE Status for any of the tender part number, will be considered for all the tendered items.
